title: Spectral Quickstart Canvas — auth/key/stream/toolcall micro-frames
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Produce a compact, re-usable asset set for the API/SDK quickstart docs that covers authentication, API key management, streaming responses, and tool-calling flows. This ticket covers design exploration, final art exports (PNG/SVG/GIF), and handoff artifacts: Figma file, high-contrast variants, dark-mode versions, and a short sprite/GIF pack for the docs site. Scope: 4 hero micro-frames (auth handshake, key rotation, streaming progress, tool-call confirmation) sized for docs hero and mobile thumbnail. 6 microcards showing step-by-step snippets (copy + visual) for inline docs. 3 short animated GIF prototypes: streaming + partial token flow, tool-call hover-to-confirm, credential refresh. Accessible color variants (AA contrast) and dark theme exports. Export spec and naming convention (PNG_2x, SVG_min, GIF_optimized). Placeholder screenshot templates for engineers to paste sanitized logs and safe demo keys. Constraints: Do not include real API keys or customer data; use synthetic demo keys and obfuscated telemetry.
acceptance_criteria: Figma master file uploaded with organized pages: /Hero, /Microcards, /GIFs, /DarkMode, /Exports
Exported assets uploaded to Drive with naming convention and 2x/1x variants
Animated GIFs under 1.5s that loop once and are <1MB each after optimization
Accessible color variants pass AA contrast for text overlays; color tokens documented
Screenshot templates with safe-demo keys and copy examples attached
Design review (design critique) completed and sign-off from PM + engineering
Handoff checklist added to the ticket and a GitHub PR created that adds final assets to the docs repository
